parole.significato: -age; forms nouns indicating an action or result related to the root verb
parole.testo: From Latin -āticum, probably through Old Occitan -atge; cf. also Old French -age, Sicilian -aju. Doublet of -atico.

From Latin sūcidus, probably through the intermediate of Old Occitan sotz. Less likely directly through a Vulgar Latin form *sud(i)cius, following metathesis. Doublet of sudicio and sucido. Compare Sicilian zuzzu (and zozzu).
